Across all three frame-level reads, chart_analyzer reports the same graph: a speed-time graph with x-axis 'Time, t (seconds)' and y-axis 'Speed (m/s)'; OCR on these frames also reads 'Speed Time Graphs', 'Speed', '(m/s)', and tick labels including '10' and '12' (avg detection confidence 0.9400).
For the needed points, chart_analyzer on frame_116.00.png, frame_118.00.png, and frame_119.50.png consistently reports v(0)=0 m/s, v(20)=10 m/s, and v(30)=12 m/s.
Using those chart_analyzer values, the average acceleration over the first 20 s is (10-0)/20 = 0.5 m/s², and over the first 30 s is (12-0)/30 = 0.4 m/s².
Adding them gives 0.5 + 0.4 = 0.9 m/s². That exact value is not among the choices, so the closest option is 0.85.
